theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: China’s Backdoor Bond-Buying Talk Swirls on $600 Billion Buildup
top_news.summary: Like many on Wall Street, DoubleLine’s Vitaliy Liberman has made a habit out of keeping tabs on foreign ownership of US debt securities, looking for signs of any broad-based pullback in retaliation for Donald Trump’s zero-sum trade policies. Month after month, he noticed something peculiar.

top_news.title: 777 Partners’ Co-Founder Wander Signals Guilty Plea in Filing
top_news.summary: Josh Wander, the 777 Partners co-founder, signaled he would plead guilty in a case that accused him of cheating lenders and investors out of almost $500 million.

top_news.title: Top Forecaster Says Fed May Hike Rates Half a Point in December
top_news.summary: A forecaster who was early to call the most recent Federal Reserve rate hike now says a bigger, half-percentage-point rate increase could be on the table in December.

top_news.title: TSMC Results Face High Bar to Calm Global AI Stock Trade Jitters
top_news.summary: With strong earnings from global chip majors failing to boost the AI trade, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. faces a high bar to impress investors.

top_news.title: Huel CEO on Danone Deal and Expansion to US Retail
top_news.summary: Huel CEO James McMaster discusses Danone’s roughly $1.2 billion acquisition of the UK-based meal-replacement and protein-shake maker. He says Huel established local manufacturing and warehouses when it entered the U.S. about eight years ago, and has since grown internationally; the company views Danone as the right partner to take it to its next stage. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Loop Capital CEO on Expanding Athlete Wealth Platform
top_news.summary: Loop Capital is buying $450 million in client assets from Lifeline Capital to expand its wealth management business and serve more athletes and entertainers. Founder, Chairman and CEO Jim Reynolds said the firm encourages athletes to invest in companies and gain ownership rather than rely on short-term endorsement payments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: S&P 500 Ends Longest Streak of Calm Since 2020 as AI Trade Sinks
top_news.summary: The US stock market’s longest streak of tranquility since before the Covid-19 pandemic is over.

top_news.title: Bitcoin Slides as Wall Street Risk Pullback Tests Bullish Turn
top_news.summary: Bitcoin fell as much as 2.3% toward the lower end of its recent trading range, caught in a broader retreat from risk assets even as crypto analysts have turned sharply more bullish on the token.

top_news.title: Oil Gains as Middle East, Russia Hostilities Imperil Flows
top_news.summary:
Oil gained Wednesday as hostilities intensified from Russia to the Middle East, threatening supply flows that only recently recovered to near pre-war levels.

Brent traded above $106 after Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched missile and drone strikes across Saudi Arabia, including a hit that damaged Saudi Aramco’s headquarters.
